metadata.name: stillpaid
metadata.description: Stillpaid: milestone escrow where silence means approval

instructions.name: accept_split
docs: The other side accepts the standing offer. `freelancer_bps` must match it,
so a last-second change of the offer cannot be accepted by accident.

instructions.name: close_job
docs: Once every milestone is closed, the job's rent goes back as well.

accounts.name: rent_payer
docs: Only whoever paid the rent may close, so nobody else can erase a settled record.

instructions.name: close_milestone
docs: Returns the rent of a settled milestone and its vault to whoever paid it.
Tokens sent to the vault after settlement go to the client first.

accounts.name: rent_payer
docs: Only whoever paid the rent may close, so nobody else can erase a settled record.

accounts.name: token_program
docs: Classic SPL Token only: Token-2022 fees, hooks or delegates could drain a vault.

errors.name: InvalidParties
errors.msg: Client, freelancer and arbiter must be three different wallets

errors.name: InvalidWindow
errors.msg: A time window is shorter than this build allows or longer than 90 days

errors.name: InvalidRevisions
errors.msg: At most 10 revisions

errors.name: InvalidTitle
errors.msg: Title must be 1 to 64 bytes

errors.name: InvalidAmount
errors.msg: Amount must be greater than zero

errors.name: InvalidDeadline
errors.msg: Delivery deadline must be in the future and at most a year out

errors.name: TooManyMilestones
errors.msg: A job can have at most 20 milestones

errors.name: AlreadyAccepted
errors.msg: The freelancer already accepted this job

errors.name: NotAccepted
errors.msg: The freelancer has not accepted this job yet

errors.name: NotFreelancer
errors.msg: Only the freelancer can do this

errors.name: NotClient
errors.msg: Only the client can do this

errors.name: NotArbiter
errors.msg: Only the arbiter can do this

errors.name: NotAParty
errors.msg: Only the client or the freelancer can do this

errors.name: WrongStatus
errors.msg: The milestone is not in the right state for this

errors.name: DeliveryLate
errors.msg: The delivery deadline has passed

errors.name: ReviewOver
errors.msg: The review window is over; silence counts as approval

errors.name: ReviewNotOver
errors.msg: The review window is still open

errors.name: RevisionsUsedUp
errors.msg: All revisions are used up; approve or open a dispute

errors.name: InvalidSplit
errors.msg: A split is given in basis points, 0 to 10000

errors.name: NoOfferFromOtherSide
errors.msg: There is no offer from the other side to accept

errors.name: OfferChanged
errors.msg: The offer changed; reload and check it again

errors.name: NoArbiter
errors.msg: This job has no arbiter

errors.name: StillNegotiating
errors.msg: The negotiation window is still open

errors.name: FallbackNotDue
errors.msg: The default split is not due yet

errors.name: NotLate
errors.msg: The freelancer accepted the job and delivery is not late yet

errors.name: UnsupportedMint
errors.msg: Only classic SPL Token mints such as USDC are supported

errors.name: Overflow
errors.msg: Arithmetic overflow

errors.name: TooEarlyToClose
errors.msg: A settled milestone stays on record for a while before it can be closed

errors.name: MilestonesOpen
errors.msg: Close all milestones first

errors.name: ArbiterTooLate
errors.msg: The arbiter deadline has passed; the default split applies

fields.name: arbiter
docs: Pubkey::default() = no arbiter: unresolved disputes end in the default split.

fields.name: fallback_bps
docs: Freelancer's share when a dispute runs out of time, agreed up front.

fields.name: amount
docs: Amount funded; payouts use the vault balance.
